acceptance: A local package root can declare both local path and pinned GitHub dependencies; local discovery follows all path branches and records remote edges without fetching.
aipo package lock <dir> --fetch-github --cache <dir> is the only network-triggering lock operation, resolves the mixed graph, and writes a complete deterministic lockfile.
The same mixed graph can be consumed by check, run, build and disasm through --package-cache with no network fallback, preserving local and GitHub provenance and physical entry paths.
Missing/corrupt cache entries, missing locks, stale locks, coordinate/version conflicts, cycles and capability widening fail closed with stable package diagnostics.

Existing local-only package behavior remains unchanged when the explicit flags are absent; tests cover mixed graph success, offline replay, failure paths and CLI argument validation; full repository gates remain green.

amendments.reason: Register the approved mixed local and remote root scope before certification

evidence.description: aipo-package default tests passed 46 cases and all-features tests passed 49 cases, including local-only remote-edge discovery, mixed graph resolution, cache-only loading, cache safety and digest verification.

aipo-cli package integration tests passed 22 cases by default and 23 with github-http, covering mixed lock creation, local and remote offline replay through check/run/build/disasm, missing cache, stale locks and CLI flag validation.
cargo test --workspace --all-targets and cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features passed; the default dependency tree remains free of ureq and no live GitHub test was used.

cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, cargo doc default/all-features, node selftest, cargo deny, cargo audit, prumo validate and prumo doctor all passed.
CLI reference, ADP-007, GitHub fetch security documentation and CHANGELOG now document mixed roots, explicit network/cache boundaries, provenance and offline replay.
prumo tool scan-secrets crates, docs and .ai reported no secrets; git diff --check passed.
